{{Top|leg}}
The '''Old Mine''' was a ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] by six kilometer cavern located a kilometer under the surface of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trilos]]. It was located one hundred and twenty kilometers away from [[New Atraken City]] and was connected via a double-tracked subway. The Old Mine was the first [[Mining/Legends|mine]] established on Trilos, and after being played out, the cavern was home to the [[Atrakenite]]'s large manufacturing equipment. A community of 10,000 also resided in the Old Mine by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], served by a single [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] also called the "[[Old Mine (cantina)|Old Mine]]."
